verdict.rationale: First-party docs advertise a GitHub Code Review feature that gives "automatic code review on every PR" and describe automating code review in CI with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD. Tagging @claude on GitHub, scheduled PR reviews, and CLAUDE.md review checklists supply project-specific context, and one community user reports Claude works well as a reviewer. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how feedback is delivered (inline PR comments, severity, configuration), and independent hands-on corroboration of the automatic every-PR review specifically.
